_howTo: Edit this file to change copy and teaser media. No code change or redeploy needed: the live site picks up changes on the next page load. Keys starting with _ are notes and are never sent to the browser. Every new teaser line or reveal image should also be posted on @ourblankthoughts (see README > Instagram tie-in).

_revealImagesHelp: Close-up teaser photos for the hidden reveal. Drop files in public/assets/reveal/ and list them here. focus = which part to crop to (CSS background-position), zoom = how tightly to crop (2 = 200%). One is picked at random per visit. While this list is empty the site shows a placeholder fabric texture.
_videoHelp: Background video. Put files in public/assets/video/ (or a CDN URL). While desktop.mp4 is null the site shows the built-in animated placeholder night scene.
